basic_info.description: A move-in ready gem in the vibrant Excelsior district of San Francisco. Newly remodeled with contemporary upgrades featuring 3 bedrooms 2 baths in 1677 thoughtfully designed living sqft. Step inside to a bright and airy modern living room with an open concept layout flowing into the newly kitchen with modern appliances, sleek countertops, and generous cabinetry storage alongside the cozy dining area. Tucked in the back, the two spacious bedrooms and a large full bath for private seclusion. Downstairs, a wet bar for entertaining and plenty of space in the backyard for hosting guests. Two car garage offering secure parking and extra storage space. Moments away from Excelsior Playground, highly rated schools, local cafes and dining from Mission St, and easy public transportation. Ready for its next chapter, come make it yours before it's gone.
